Stoneware mug. With subliminal print designs, dependent on the customers requirements. A dye-sublimation printer prints a custom design onto a special transfer paper using sublimation inks. The paper is then placed onto a product (enamel or ceramic mug, t-shirt, or other) and both are put into a sublimation heat transfer press, applying immense heat and pressure at once. The heat turns the inks into a gas, and the poly material absorbs it. The result is a permanent, vibrant print that doesn’t lay on the surface of the product; instead, it becomes one with a previously applied poly coating on the surface, which is the key feature of sublimation printing. This coating allows the sublimation ink to bind tightly to the mug, creating a vibrant and long-lasting print. The company purchases one size mugs of 11 fl oz, plain white poly coated mugs in bulk packaging, who then apply the subliminal print designs to the mugs, to a customer’s requirements. Packaging: 12 mugs of a capacity of 11 Fl oz, are packed into divided cells in a cardboard box for transport.

The seat & the backs of these have a textilene fabric secured inside of the frame, so they can be used without the removable cushions. The chair dimension – 69.5*56.5*105cm. The cushions are of a grey woven polyester fabric. This fabric is not waterproof. Dimensions – 680*750*1040mm. A powder coated gunmetal grey aluminium framed dining table, measuring 74cm high, with a printed glass top with a hole in the middle for an umbrella to be placed in. (This is not included with this set) The table is set on 4 angled legs. It is packaged all together in 3 separate carboard cartons for assembly in the home.

A wooden chair made solely of pine. It was designed by architect and designer Lina Bo Bardi. The chair was made for the Serviço Social do Comércio (SESC) in Pompéia, São Paulo, Brazil. The dimensions of the chair are 69.9cm x 39.4cm x 51.4cm.

A folding camping chair. It has an iron frame and is covered with 600D Oxford fabric. It comes with a drawstring fabric bag for packing the chair into when not in use. It is packaged with an information insert card.

Designer: Ettore Sottsass . Object: ‘Harlow TPA 240’ dining table and set of six ‘Harlow S 44’ chairs . Date: Circa 1971 . Ettore Sottsass (1917–2007) is universally recognised as one of the most influential designers of the twentieth century. His work transformed the fields of furniture, architecture, industrial design, ceramics, and decorative arts, and he is regarded as one of the defining figures of post-war international design. Materials: Aluminium, fibreglass, painted wood, fabric . Dimensions: Dining table: 72 x 240 x 80 cm . Chairs (each): 85 x 62 x 46 cm .

This submission is for the parachute container assembly complete with packed parachute and parachute riser straps to attach to the occupant’s flight harness. The parachute container assembly is a predominantly aluminium casing that is projected away from the seat during an emergency ejection to deploy and unravel the parachute for the seat occupant to descend under. The parachute container also includes an ethylene foam head pad for the occupant’s head to rest against during flight and canopy breakers to pierce the canopy of the aircraft during ejection. The parachute and parachute container form part of an ejection seat. This assembly is designed specifically for use as part of an ejection seat.

An operating table that can be configured according to surgical procedure and includes a smart remote control with intuitive functions for steering, configuring, and viewing the selected movement and the position of the table on screen. The operating tables are manufactured from durable materials which aid decontamination post-procedure.

A ‘smart-watch’ – a device designed to be worn on the wrist in the same way as a traditional wrist watch. It comprises an electronic assembly powered by a rechargeable battery, connected to a touch sensitive AMOLED display and encased in a metal and glass housing. It is capable of communicating wirelessly to a paired device via Bluetooth as well as connecting to the internet using its built in Wi-Fi hardware. However, it can also be set up and used to tell the time without connection to a phone and the time can be set manually. Other hardware includes a microphone, GPS, speaker, 2GB RAM, 16GB internal storage and a touch sensitive bezel. The device also has software installed including that which that allows the user to remotely take calls coming through to a connected smart-phone but it cannot make nor receive calls directly as there is no telephony hardware support nor provision for installing a SIM card. The device has a round face which measures approximately 45mm in diameter and is packaged into a box with straps and a USB wireless charging dock without power supply

The Smart Watch has a 1.6" AMOLED display with Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity. Once fully charge the smart watch has up to 14 days battery life. The smart watch has a multi-system standalone GPS and is 5ATM water resistance. The smart watch is suitable for Android 6.0 or later iOS 10.0 or later. The smart watch has a Sensors Optical heart rate sensor (24-hour heart rate tracking), accelerometer, gyroscope, electronic compass, ambient light sensor and also gives a blood oxygen saturation level (SpO₂) measurement anytime anywhere for a peace of mind. The product Weights 31g (including strap) and the dimensions are 39.1 x 34.4 x 9.98 mm. Watch strap material TPU – Strap Adjustable Package contents Watch body x 1 Watch strap x1 Charging cable x1User manual x1. Watch comes in 3 colours – Blue, Black and Ivory also Spare wrist straps come in Pink and Olive

A plastic watch with a projector. There are 2 function buttons, by using the first function button the display will change between the date and time . The second function button enables the projector, by continually pressing the button the projected image can be changed. There are 24 dinosaur images, which are emitted from the lens at the side of the watch. The images can be focused by twisting the focus ring. The watch can be fastened to the wrist with the buckle on the strap, alternatively the face can be removed from the strap and placed on the side as a bedside clock. It measures approximately 204mm x 30mm. The watch with projector requires 4 LR41 batteries which are included, it is recommended for ages 3 years+. It is packaged within an open card retail box, an instruction leaflet is also included.

A Magnetic wireless charger. The product is used for wireless charging for smart watches. Also known as inductive charging, to transfer power to a device using electromagnetic induction. The material is made from polycarbonate or other thermoplastic, and components are coils, wires, and magnets. The USB-C connector is made from aluminium and is lightweight. Packaged in retail pack.

The product is jewellery display stand, made from rubberwood and with a velour cover plinth pad and mounted onto a small wood post. The total height is 8cm the width of the display pad is 20cm in length and the wood base is 6cm x 12cm. Product is without any packaging.

A screen protector for a smartwatch. It is made from tempered glass and polycarbonate material. It is robust and waterproof, providing complete protection from scratches and bumps. It comes in sizes 38mm, 40mm and 42mm and various colours.
A 24pc pack of Lithium Cell Button Batteries. Can be used in calculators, watches etc. This product comes packaged in a blister card.

Pack of 34 Chrome-vanadium steel (CRV) screwdriver bit set supplied in bulk quantities. Includes CRV bits in a case to be used with power tools and screwdrivers. The product is heat treated. The set includes: 32 Chrome vanadium bits 2 Pack soft touch case 60mm Magnetic bit holder The case which holds the bit set is packaged in blister packaging which also has a gap at the top for hanging display.

A multipurpose tool. It is a 4-in-1 shovel, rake, saw and bottle opener. It has a steel shovel head with a plastic and rubber handle. It comes with a protective pouch for storage. It comes with a cardboard swing tag on the handle for retail purposes.

Handheld gardening trowel to dig up soil. It has an Ash wooden handle and stainless steel trowel with a thin leather strap tied to the handle. Packaged on cardboard backing and a plastic blister cover.

GasGrab is a manual handling tool which is used to lift gas cylinders (bottles) by hand in a safe and controlled manner. The device is made from cast LM6 aluminium alloy (recycled) with NR/SBR rubber grip-pads. It is made by joining two of the aluminium castings with steel rivets, powder coating them, and finally gluing the rubber grip-pads on with cyanoacrylate adhesive. The GasGrab works by clamping to the cylinder when the handles are lifted upward, pivoting around the rivets allowing the cylinder to be lifted and carried by hand. Each device is packaged in its own cardboard box, along with instructions and a declaration of conformity.

Pack of 6 cabinet handle screwdrivers sold in a set in wholesale quantities. These come as a set for multipurpose DIY use. The screwdrivers consist of 3 Flathead and 3 Phillips. The shanks of the screwdrivers are made of carbon steel.
12-inch Adjustable Wrench supplied in large quantities. This product is a tool to use for a wide range of DIY use. It has a 38mm jaw capacity, drog forged and metric scaled.

The heavy duty machinery is designed and built for tree trunk milling, suitable for growers and wholesalers. It is supplied with a 50mm diameter machined aluminium twin bladed head capable of milling up to 125mm and accepts butt sizes up to 180mm. The blades are set in front of wide openings on the head which enables the rapid removal of unwanted bottom branches without blocking the machine. There is a automatic motor brake which is linked to a foot pedal and sensors on the hinged safety cover. Heavy duty high torque reduction gearbox, shaft and bearings. Thermal overload protection Power supply 230v 16 amp - Power 2.2Kw - 550 RPM - Weight 75kg
